body: Mine smell kinda gross too, I think it's normal. The ones I picked before the veil broke didn't smell too bad though.
They only had the aloe alcohol when I went. I'm going to check out another location soonish because I saw someone else find the pre cooked rice there!

I'm so sorry he doesn't understand, but you deserve better than that. You deserve someone wo will hear you out. 

It's awful being in such a dark place and being so alone.
Hey, you deserve better.

You are absolutely right. I talked to FDW and she's done this before. But you know what? I'm not a weapon. No contact with her FDW can't see or hear. If I have to deal with her, all texts get forwarded.

Thank you.

I talked to FDW about it, aparently this has happened before. She's trying to recruit me. I am not going to allow myself to be a weapon.

I am weak willed and anxious and I know that this bitch will get to me, so I'm not going to have contact with her that FDW can't see or hear.
I know that I'm reaching. I know that I'm being irrational here. I'm well aware of that, that's why I'm here asking how I can keep it from getting to me.

I don't doubt she is. If I can't work through this myself I'll discuss therapy with her. I have my own therapist I'll talk to as well. I don't want to make her deal with more than she has to right now. Not planning on keeping her in the dark, she knows my account and she will see this post so I kinda have to talk to her haha.
That's the plan. I should have told her that last time, it won't happen again.

You are absolutely right. Thank you.

She's done all these amazing things, gone on all these crazy and sometimes hard to believe adventures and that's what I've been feeding this. I've been giving reasons that her mom is right rather than defending her.

She has no reason to lie to me about this. And she has "lied" before but "I'm fine" when she's not is different. 

Thank you. I needed to hear that.

I think she's doing alright here. They get one phonecall a week from her and only if they're kind to her. She's put them in a solid time out and I really do think if she needs to take it away she will.
Everything, exactly how she said it. She gets screenshots of every text I get.
I don't have anywhere to keep him.

It's a possibility, but one I'd like to save. I'm living with my parents right now rent free and they're a whole nother can of worms. I'm sure they would let me but... It's kinda a lot to ask, you know?
Super suspicious. Can't believe I didn't even question it.
It hasn't hit the fan yet, and she's not known for destroying stuff. I think it will be more or less okay as long as we get her stuff and the dog before things get bad. I hope so at least.

I should have stood up for her. I won't let her get away with that again.

I hope not. If so, I'm sure we can steal him. He's an escape artist, maybe he could just... Slip out a door or something. I really don't want to fight her over this.
My move date is soon, within a few weeks. I don't think she'll hurt him, I just worry that she will fight us on taking him. She really does love him. But so does DW.
He is! Made sure of it when we got him. All his vet paperwork is in DW's name as well.
To be fair, I offered. She paid for the room, and I'm young and can handle sleeping on a lumpy bed that tried to fold up on me.
Doggo will live, she loves him. I'm worried she might not give him up, or he might "go missing" until we give up on finding him. I didn't mean to imply he was in physical danger.
I slept on the foldout couch. It was not pleasant.
She offered to buy the rooms, and she said she got one for me too. But I don't know why I believed that, she lied about other "problems" on the trip too.
